notes: Values were checked on 4 individual skill pages: warrior/power-strike, warrior/slash-blast, fighter/rage, fighter/sword-mastery. Every other skill comes from its class listing page, which shows only the max level, unlock gate, tags and a short description.

Prerequisites come from the listing's nesting (a child skill indented under a parent and marked 'Unlocks at Lv N'), so they are inferred. Only slash-blast <- power-strike Lv 1 is stated on a skill page.

Not confirmed (not shown on the pages fetched): dmgPct for the six Final Attack skills and for Rush; MP costs for every skill except power-strike, slash-blast and rage; stat values and durations for iron-body, iron-will, threaten, the boosters, the masteries other than fighter/sword-mastery, max-hp-increase, improved-hp-recovery and precise-strikes.
Rush differs between listings: Fighter and Spearman say up to 6 monsters with a 2 s cooldown, but the Page listing says up to 4 monsters with a 1 s cooldown. Each job records its own listing.

Final Attack targets: the Fighter listing says up to 3 enemies in front, and the Spearman listing says a single enemy. The Page listing describes a single-target hit for the shared Final Attack: Sword, which conflicts with Fighter's, so targets are omitted for Page's Final Attack entries.

Sword Mastery: the fighter skill page shows that at launch (2026-10-06) the side bonus changed from Weapon Def (+90 at max) to Accuracy (+20 at max). The Page listing still describes Sword Mastery as raising Weapon Def; the Page copy was not checked on its own page.

Classic changes kept as current values: Slash Blast targets 4 -> 6, MP at max 12 -> 14, HP cost at max 8 -> 16 (COT2 -> launch, 2026-10-06); Rage Attack Power +35 -> +40 and Weapon Def -35 -> -40 (COT1 -> COT2).
The Warrior 1st-job listing was read from the English class page (/msclassic/classes/warrior), because the /msclassic/skills/warrior URL was not reachable.
